<?php
/**
 * Real-time Chat Server with Connection Pooling
 * Uses raw TCP sockets for WebSocket-like communication
 */

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $connections = [];
    private array $metadata = [];
    private int $maxConnections = 100;

    public function addConnection($socket, string $nickname): bool {
        if (count($this->connections) >= $this->maxConnections) {
            return false;
        }
        $id = (int)$socket;
        $this->connections[$id] = $socket;
        $this->metadata[$id] = [
            'nickname' => $nickname,
            'joined_at' => time(),
            'room' => 'general'
        ];
        return true;
    }

    public function removeConnection($socket): void {
        $id = (int)$socket;
        unset($this->connections[$id], $this->metadata[$id]);
    }

    public function getConnections(): array {
        return $this->connections;
    }

    public function getMetadata(int $id): ?array {
        return $this->metadata[$id] ?? null;
    }

    public function setRoom(int $id, string $room): void {
        if (isset($this->metadata[$id])) {
            $this->metadata[$id]['room'] = $room;
        }
    }
}

class MessageProtocol {
    const HEADER_TERMINATOR = "\r\n";
    const FIELD_SEPARATOR = ": ";

    /**
     * Encode a chat message into wire format.
     * Format:
     *   Type: message\r\n
     *   From: <nickname>\r\n
     *   Room: <room>\r\n
     *   Timestamp: <ts>\r\n
     *   \r\n
     *   <body>
     */
    public static function encode(string $type, string $from, string $room, string $body): string {
        $headers = self::buildHeaders($type, $from, $room);
        return $headers . self::HEADER_TERMINATOR . $body;
    }

    private static function buildHeaders(string $type, string $from, string $room): string {
        $lines = [];
        $lines[] = "Type" . self::FIELD_SEPARATOR . $type;
        $lines[] = "From" . self::FIELD_SEPARATOR . self::sanitizeHeaderValue($from);
        $lines[] = "Room" . self::FIELD_SEPARATOR . $room;
        $lines[] = "Timestamp" . self::FIELD_SEPARATOR . date('c');
        return implode(self::HEADER_TERMINATOR, $lines) . self::HEADER_TERMINATOR;
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize header values to prevent injection.
     * Removes null bytes and vertical whitespace that could break framing.
     */
    private static function sanitizeHeaderValue(string $value): string {
        // Remove null bytes and vertical tabs
        $value = str_replace(["\x00", "\x0B"], '', $value);
        // Collapse horizontal whitespace
        $value = preg_replace('/[\t ]+/', ' ', $value);
        return trim($value);
    }

    /**
     * Parse incoming client command.
     * Commands: /join <room>, /nick <name>, /msg <text>
     */
    public static function parseCommand(string $raw): ?array {
        $raw = trim($raw);
        if (str_starts_with($raw, '/join ')) {
            return ['cmd' => 'join', 'arg' => substr($raw, 6)];
        } elseif (str_starts_with($raw, '/nick ')) {
            return ['cmd' => 'nick', 'arg' => substr($raw, 6)];
        } elseif (str_starts_with($raw, '/msg ')) {
            return ['cmd' => 'msg', 'arg' => substr($raw, 5)];
        }
        // Default: treat entire input as message
        return ['cmd' => 'msg', 'arg' => $raw];
    }
}

class ChatServer {
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private $serverSocket;
    private array $bannedWords = ['spam', 'phish'];

    public function __construct(string $host = '0.0.0.0', int $port = 9000) {
        $this->pool = new ConnectionPool();
        $this->serverSocket = stream_socket_server(
            "tcp://{$host}:{$port}",
            $errno, $errstr
        );
        if (!$this->serverSocket) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Server start failed: {$errstr}");
        }
    }

    public function run(): void {
        while (true) {
            $read = array_merge([$this->serverSocket], $this->pool->getConnections());
            $write = $except = null;
            if (stream_select($read, $write, $except, 1) > 0) {
                foreach ($read as $socket) {
                    if ($socket === $this->serverSocket) {
                        $this->acceptConnection();
                    } else {
                        $this->handleClientData($socket);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function acceptConnection(): void {
        $client = stream_socket_accept($this->serverSocket);
        if ($client) {
            fwrite($client, "NICK?\n");
            $nick = trim(fgets($client, 64));
            if ($this->validateNickname($nick)) {
                $this->pool->addConnection($client, $nick);
                $this->broadcastSystemMessage("{$nick} joined the chat", 'general');
            } else {
                fwrite($client, "Invalid nickname\n");
                fclose($client);
            }
        }
    }

    private function validateNickname(string $nick): bool {
        // Allow alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, 3-20 chars
        return (bool)preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{3,20}$/', $nick);
    }

    private function handleClientData($socket): void {
        $data = fgets($socket, 4096);
        if ($data === false || $data === '') {
            $this->disconnectClient($socket);
            return;
        }

        $id = (int)$socket;
        $meta = $this->pool->getMetadata($id);
        if (!$meta) return;

        $command = MessageProtocol::parseCommand($data);
        if (!$command) return;

        switch ($command['cmd']) {
            case 'join':
                $this->handleJoin($id, $socket, $command['arg']);
                break;
            case 'nick':
                $this->handleNickChange($id, $socket, $command['arg']);
                break;
            case 'msg':
                $this->handleMessage($id, $meta, $command['arg']);
                break;
        }
    }

    private function handleJoin(int $id, $socket, string $room): void {
        $room = $this->sanitizeRoomName($room);
        $this->pool->setRoom($id, $room);
        fwrite($socket, "Joined room: {$room}\n");
    }

    private function sanitizeRoomName(string $room): string {
        return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', substr(trim($room), 0, 30));
    }

    private function handleNickChange(int $id, $socket, string $newNick): void {
        if (!$this->validateNickname($newNick)) {
            fwrite($socket, "Invalid nickname\n");
            return;
        }
        // Re-register with new nick
        $meta = $this->pool->getMetadata($id);
        $this->broadcastSystemMessage("{$meta['nickname']} is now {$newNick}", $meta['room']);
    }

    private function handleMessage(int $id, array $meta, string $text): void {
        $text = $this->filterContent($text);
        if (empty($text)) return;

        $encoded = MessageProtocol::encode(
            'message',
            $meta['nickname'],
            $meta['room'],
            $text
        );

        $this->broadcastToRoom($encoded, $meta['room'], $id);
    }

    private function filterContent(string $text): string {
        $text = trim($text);
        foreach ($this->bannedWords as $word) {
            $text = str_ireplace($word, '***', $text);
        }
        return $text;
    }

    private function broadcastToRoom(string $data, string $room, int $excludeId = -1): void {
        foreach ($this->pool->getConnections() as $id => $conn) {
            if ($id === $excludeId) continue;
            $connMeta = $this->pool->getMetadata($id);
            if ($connMeta && $connMeta['room'] === $room) {
                fwrite($conn, $data);
            }
        }
    }

    private function broadcastSystemMessage(string $text, string $room): void {
        $encoded = MessageProtocol::encode('system', 'SERVER', $room, $text);
        $this->broadcastToRoom($encoded, $room);
    }

    private function disconnectClient($socket): void {
        $id = (int)$socket;
        $meta = $this->pool->getMetadata($id);
        if ($meta) {
            $this->broadcastSystemMessage("{$meta['nickname']} left", $meta['room']);
        }
        $this->pool->removeConnection($socket);
        fclose($socket);
    }
}

// Entry point
try {
    $server = new ChatServer('0.0.0.0', (int)($argv[1] ?? 9000));
    $server->run();
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    fprintf(STDERR, "Fatal: %s\n", $e->getMessage());
    exit(1);
}
